name: inspect_native_dispatch_metadata
description: Inspect the bound provider's name inventory for Objective-C class/method symbols and Swift mangled symbols, returning at most max_records decoded names. Optional objc_class_import_addresses request exact pointer-slot binding facts for those addresses; they are decoded only from the selected Mach-O slice and retain partial or unsupported coverage when not established. Includes target SHA-256 when available, provider identity/version, analysis-profile digest, facet coverage, and per-record Evidence. This is static symbol and metadata evidence, not runtime metadata: ivar layouts, protocol conformances, witness/class tables, and relative pointers are explicitly marked unsupported unless a provider supplies those decoders. The provider controls how its name inventory is acquired.

max_records.description: Maximum permitted records for this operation.

objc_class_import_addresses.description: Optional exact pointer-slot addresses from the selected name inventory; used to report decoded Objective-C class import bindings.

objc_class_import_addresses_complete.description: Whether the candidate addresses include every selected class-label row; false keeps binding coverage partial when the existing record budget truncates the scan.
